question: total building footprint area km2
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1e6 AS total_area_km2 FROM lisbon_buildings;

question: building footprints larger than 1000 sqm
sql: SELECT id, ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) AS area_sqm, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) > 1000;

question: longest road segment meters
sql: SELECT id, ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry) AS length_m FROM lisbon_roads ORDER BY length_m DESC LIMIT 1;

question: total length of residential roads km
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000 AS total_length_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential';

question: buildings taller than 50m with footprint under 500 sqm
sql: SELECT id, height, ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) AS area_sqm FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE height > 50 AND ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) < 500;

question: road network length inside central Lisbon bbox km
sql: WITH bbox AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.15, 38.71, -9.10, 38.75) AS geom) SELECT SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true))) / 1000 AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads r, bbox b WHERE ST_Intersects(r.geometry, b.geom);
